name: Rice Noodles
siboNotes: Rice noodles are well-tolerated and easier to digest than wheat-based noodles, making them suitable for SIBO management.
preparationTips: Rinse thoroughly before cooking to remove excess starch
Don't overcook - they can become mushy quickly
Add to soups at the end of cooking to prevent over-softening
Soak thin varieties in hot water rather than boiling
nutritionalHighlights: Low in fiber compared to wheat noodles
Contains small amounts of iron and B vitamins
Lower protein content than wheat pasta
